title: Generating Long Sequences with Sparse Transformers
authors: R. Child, S. Gray, A. Radford, I. Sutskever
before: Self-attention compared every position with every other, at quadratic cost.
problem: Quadratic cost makes long sequences unaffordable in both time and memory.
breakthrough: Factorise the attention pattern so each position attends to a structured subset, reducing cost to O(n sqrt n).
why: It started the sparse-attention line that runs through Longformer and BigBird to DeepSeek's sparse attention in 2025.
next: GPT-3 used these patterns; Longformer and BigBird generalised them.
inherits: Sparse attention as the standard lever for long context.
